prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts the interior of a fire station garage with clean lines and solid colors. On the left stands a tall firefighter in a yellow helmet, holding a clipboard with a serious expression. In the center, a shiny red fire truck is parked, its chrome bumper gleaming under the indoor lights. Perched on the front bumper of the truck is a small orange cat, grooming its paw with casual indifference. To the right of the truck, a mechanic in blue overalls kneels on the floor, inspecting the rear tire with a focused gaze. Standing next to the mechanic is a golden retriever, sitting patiently with its tail wrapped around its paws. Behind the group, near the large open bay door, a woman in a green jacket points toward the ceiling, directing attention to a hanging hose reel. The firefighter in the yellow helmet looks at the woman in the green jacket, acknowledging her signal. The mechanic in blue overalls reaches out to pat the golden retriever, offering a brief moment of affection amidst the work. The small orange cat remains aloof, ignoring the humans entirely. The scene is orderly and calm, with no smoke or fire visible anywhere in the frame. There is no chaos or emergency depicted, only routine maintenance and preparation. The spatial arrangement places the firefighter on the far left, the truck and cat in the middle, and the mechanic, dog, and woman on the right side of the composition. Each character is distinct by their clothing or species, ensuring clear visual separation without the need for labels or text.
